templates.pattern: 5×5 grid: Red at (2,3), Blue at (4,1), Green at (1,5). Triangle area formed?
templates.explanation: Triangle area using coordinates formula = 5 square units

templates.pattern: 6×6 path from (1,1) to (6,6). One obstacle at (3,3). Min steps avoiding it?
templates.explanation: Direct path is 10 steps. One obstacle adds 2 extra steps = 12

templates.pattern: Knight's tour: Start (1,1). After [N] L-moves, how many cells visited?
templates.explanation: [N] moves visits [N]+1 cells (including start)

templates.pattern: Grid spiral: Start center of 5×5. After 8 steps spiraling outward, at which row?
templates.explanation: Spiral pattern from center (3,3) after 8 steps reaches row 2

templates.pattern: 8-queens: Place 4 queens on 4×4 board, no attacks. Is this possible?
templates.explanation: 4-queens has solution on 4×4 board

templates.pattern: Manhattan distance from (1,1) to ([X],[Y]). X=[A], Y=[B]?
templates.explanation: Manhattan distance = |[A]-1| + |[B]-1| = [A]-1 + [B]-1

templates.pattern: Bishop at (4,4) in 8×8 board. How many cells reachable in 1 move?
templates.explanation: Bishop from (4,4) reaches 13 diagonal cells within 8×8 board

templates.pattern: 4×4 grid folds in half vertically. Cell at row 2, column 1. New column after fold?
templates.explanation: Vertical fold: column 1 overlaps with column 4 (5-1=4)

templates.pattern: Rook on (3,3). King on (3,5). Can rook capture king in 1 move?
templates.explanation: Rook and King share same row (3), so rook can capture

templates.pattern: Torus 4×4 wraps. From (4,4), move right 2, down 3. New row number?
templates.explanation: From row 4, down 3 with wrapping: (4+3) mod 4 = 3 (wraps to row 3)

templates.pattern: Grid graph: 5×5 grid connects adjacent cells. How many edges total?
templates.explanation: 5×5 grid: 20 horizontal + 20 vertical edges = 40

templates.pattern: Checkerboard 7×7 grid, alternating colors starting with black. How many black cells?
templates.explanation: 7×7=49 cells. Starting black: 25 black, 24 white

templates.pattern: Domino tiling: 2×5 grid. How many ways to tile with 1×2 dominoes?
templates.explanation: 2×5 tiling follows Fibonacci: F(6) = 8

templates.pattern: Queen on (1,1) in 8×8 board. How many cells can it attack?
templates.explanation: Queen from corner attacks 21 cells (7 row + 7 column + 7 diagonal)

templates.pattern: Hamiltonian path: Visit all cells once in 3×3. Approx paths from (1,1) to (3,3)?
templates.explanation: 3×3 grid corner to corner Hamiltonian paths: 8

templates.pattern: Hexagonal grid: Center cell touches how many neighbors?
templates.explanation: Hexagonal grid cells have 6 neighbors

templates.pattern: 4×4 grid coloring. Min colors needed so adjacent cells differ?
templates.explanation: Even×even grid needs only 2 colors (checkerboard)

templates.pattern: 5×5 grid: How many total diagonals (both directions)?
templates.explanation: 5×5 has 9 diagonals each direction = 18 total

templates.pattern: 4×4 checkerboard bipartite graph. Max matching size?
templates.explanation: 4×4 checkerboard has 8 black and 8 white cells, max matching = 8

templates.pattern: 5×5 maze from (1,1) to (5,5). 3 wall cells block path. Min steps?
templates.explanation: Direct = 8 steps. 3 walls add ~4 detour = 12 steps

templates.pattern: 10×10 grid, 70% cells open. Does path exist top to bottom?
templates.explanation: 70% > 59% percolation threshold, path likely exists

templates.pattern: Voronoi: Points at (1,1), (5,5), (3,5). Cell (3,3) closest to which?
templates.explanation: Distance from (3,3): to (1,1)=4, to (5,5)=4, to (3,5)=2. Closest is point 3

templates.pattern: Rotate 5×5 grid 180°. Cell (2,3) moves to?
Cellular automaton: 4 cells start alive. Rule: survive if 2-3 neighbors. After 1 step?
templates.explanation: Conway's Game of Life rules applied to 4-cell pattern gives 3 survivors
